### Changed

- Renamed the user-visible desktop product from Coding to Or. The application
  bundle, window title, startup messages, permission copy, and public
  documentation now use the Or name.
- Changed GitHub Release titles to match the version tag directly, such as
  `v0.6.5`.
- Kept sessions, transcripts, provider settings, prompt templates, and skills
  under the existing `~/.or` data directory, so the rename requires no data
  migration.

### Fixed

- Added an explicit architecture to every macOS artifact name, preventing the
  Intel build from being mistaken for the Apple Silicon build. Downloads are
  now named `Or-0.6.5-arm64.dmg`, `Or-0.6.5-arm64.zip`,
  `Or-0.6.5-x64.dmg`, and `Or-0.6.5-x64.zip`.
- Updated release validation and macOS signature checks for the renamed
  `Or.app` bundle.

### Upgrade Notes

- `Or.app` does not replace an existing `Coding.app` by filename. Quit Coding,
  install and open Or, then remove the old application after confirming Or
  starts normally.
- The macOS builds support macOS 12 or later and are ad-hoc signed, but are not
  notarized. macOS may require approval under **System Settings > Privacy &
  Security** after the first launch attempt.
